canary_provisioning_plan: P1: operator provides AF2N_GRAFANA_URL, AF2N_GRAFANA_API_TOKEN, AF2N_DASHBOARD_FOLDER_UID, AF2N_ALERT_SINK_URL via secret vault
P2: dry-run dashboard render against local templates; verify shape
P3: operator signs OPS_APPROVAL gate (exact text from 130F)
P4: dry-run alert to sink; receive ack; operator signs ALERT_SINK_CONFIGURED
P5: scrape data source UID; verify metrics healthy; operator signs DASHBOARD_DATA_SOURCE_CONFIGURED
P6: QA audit logs and templates; operator signs NO_SECRET_LEAKAGE
P7: rollback dry-run; verify no-op path; operator signs ROLLBACK_NO_OP_PATH
P8: only when all 5 gates SIGNED, schedule live provisioning window
